name: Applied Co.,Ltd.
summary: Applied Co.,Ltd. sells personal computers, peripheral equipment, and digital products in Japan. It is also involved in the planning, development, manufacture, sale, and wholesale of private brand PCs and digital products. The company also engages in the procurement, advertising, and sale of products of other manufacturers. In addition, it provides network system construction and maintenance, and remote services. The company was founded in 1977 and is headquartered in Fukuoka City, Japan.
